brief.title: Fix up-next episode selection for season progression

lines.text: """Return the next episode after the user's latest watched point.
``released_episodes`` must already be ordered by season/episode number.
This avoids recommending an earlier, previously-unwatched episode from an
older season when the user has already progressed to a later season.
next_episode = await find_next_episode(db_session, user.id, show.id, date(2024, 2, 10))
